findings.title: verify ignores session expiry
findings.description: verify scans sessions and returns a match without checking expiresAt, so expired tokens remain valid.

findings.title: requireAdmin rejects admins
findings.description: allowed.indexOf returns 0 for 'admin', which is falsy, so the condition fails for the very role it should allow.

findings.title: bearerToken dereferences possibly undefined header
findings.description: header! and parts[1]! crash when the Authorization header is missing or malformed instead of yielding an empty/invalid token.

findings.title: parseLifetimeHours produces NaN without radix
findings.description: parseInt(raw) can return NaN for invalid input and uses default radix.

findings.title: LRU eviction picks insertion order, not LRU
findings.description: Victim selection uses entries.keys().next(), evicting the oldest insertion rather than the least recently used entry despite the used counter.

findings.title: set leaks/replaces timers on overwrite
findings.description: A new setTimeout is registered without clearing any prior timer for the same code, leaking timers and deleting the newer entry on expiry.

findings.title: delete does not cancel scheduled timer
findings.description: delete removes the entry but leaves the setTimeout running, a resource leak that may resurrect stale handling.

findings.title: peek does not account for expiry
findings.description: peek reports true for entries whose TTL has elapsed.

findings.title: utilization truncates to zero for partial fullness
findings.description: Math.floor(size / limit) * 100 truncates the ratio before scaling, so any cache below 100% reports 0%.

findings.title: keys() always returns an empty array
findings.description: Iterating a Map with for...in does not enumerate entries, so the admin view never sees cached codes.

findings.title: loadConfig mutates the shared DEFAULT_CONFIG
findings.description: cfg aliases DEFAULT_CONFIG, so env overrides permanently alter the defaults for all later calls.

findings.title: Bad LINKD_TIMEOUT_MS sets NaN instead of default
findings.description: When ms is NaN the code logs a warning but still assigns cfg.timeoutMs = ms.

findings.title: Cache TTL multiplied by 1000 despite being milliseconds
findings.description: Documentation says LINKD_CACHE_TTL_MS is already milliseconds, but the loader multiplies by 1000, inflating TTL 1000x.

findings.title: LINKD_FETCH_LIMIT parsed but never applied
findings.description: cfg.fetchLimit stays at its default because the parsed value is discarded.

findings.title: validate always returns true even with problems
findings.description: The function collects problems but returns true regardless, failing to refuse bad configuration.

findings.title: parseReport emits a bogus empty row for trailing newline
findings.description: A trailing newline splits into an empty final line, which is converted into a row of undefined cells.

findings.title: createLink lets JSON.parse throw unhandled
findings.description: Malformed request bodies crash the handler instead of producing a 400 response.

findings.title: redirect crashes when code is missing
findings.description: req.query['code']! is asserted non-null then .toLowerCase() is called, throwing on undefined.

findings.title: stats divides by zero when store is empty
findings.description: store.totalHits() / store.size() yields NaN/Infinity for an empty store.

findings.title: resolve expiry condition is inverted
findings.description: Non-expired links are deleted and return undefined while expired links stay resolvable, the opposite of intended behavior.

findings.title: quota bookkeeping produces NaN
findings.description: this.quota[owner] is undefined on first creation, so +1 yields NaN.

findings.title: successRate truncates to zero below 100%
findings.description: Math.floor(used / size) * 100 truncates the ratio before scaling.

findings.title: top sorts ascending instead of descending
findings.description: The comparator returns -1 when a.hits <= b.hits, ordering least-followed first.

findings.title: byOwner uses substring match
findings.description: l.owner.includes(owner) returns links for owners whose names merely contain the query string.

findings.title: extend revives/sets expiry on expired links
findings.description: extend always sets expiresAt = now + ttl, resurrecting links that should stay expired.

findings.title: quotas returns internal mutable reference
findings.description: Returning this.quota lets callers mutate store state despite the snapshot contract.

findings.title: delete does not refund owner quota
findings.description: The documented quota slot return never happens, so deleted links still count against the owner.

findings.title: importAll is not atomic and skips quota accounting
findings.description: Links are added incrementally with validation mid-way, and quotas are never updated.

findings.title: prune returns store size instead of removed count
findings.description: The method counts removed but returns this.links.size.

findings.title: rename validates 'from' twice, never 'to'
findings.description: validateCode is called twice on from while to is unchecked, allowing invalid destination codes.

findings.title: expiresAt dereferences missing link
findings.description: this.links.get(code)! throws when code is absent instead of signaling missing.

findings.title: warmCache does not await probes
findings.description: forEach with async callbacks returns immediately, so callers cannot know when priming finished.

findings.title: flushAudit neither awaits nor retries
findings.description: The registered function's returned promise is ignored, contradicting the retry-until-success contract.

findings.title: countForOwner can return NaN
findings.description: quotas[owner] may be undefined, producing NaN when incremented/added.

findings.title: checkTargets rejects on probe throw instead of reporting failure
findings.description: probe throws for insecure targets, so Promise.all rejects rather than returning the first failing target.

findings.title: Cache.set schedules expiry timers it never cancels, so stale timers delete newer entries
findings.description: set() overwrites an entry for a code (and evicts a victim) while leaving any previously scheduled setTimeout for that code/victim armed. When the old timer later fires it calls delete(code) on whatever entry now occupies that code, evicting a fresh value prematurely and, for reused codes, nuking a newer cache entry. delete() also never clears its own timer. Interleaving: set(A), wait, set(A) again, then the first timer fires and removes the second value.

findings.title: warmCache fire-and-forgets its async probes, so it resolves before the cache is primed
findings.description: pairs.forEach(async ...) creates one promise per entry but never awaits them, and forEach returns void. Callers see warmCache resolve immediately while probes/cache writes are still pending; a probe rejection becomes an unhandled promise rejection instead of propagating. Downstream reads can race the in-flight priming writes.

findings.title: checkTargets cannot cancel remaining probes after a failure
findings.description: It awaits Promise.all over all probes, so every probe runs to completion even after an earlier one fails, contradicting the documented 'remaining probes abandoned once a failure is seen'. There is no AbortSignal/timeout threaded into probe(), so in-flight work keeps running and can mutate shared state after the result is returned.

findings.title: flushAudit discards its promise, so writes are never awaited or retried
findings.description: write() returns a Promise<void>, but flushAudit invokes write() and drops the result. Rejections are unhandled, and the documented 'retried until it succeeds' never happens, so an audit sync failure is silently lost.

findings.title: The janitor interval handle is discarded, so the timer can never be stopped
findings.description: startJanitor returns a stop function, but main() ignores it. The interval keeps firing for the process lifetime and cannot be cleared on shutdown or reconfiguration, leaking a background task that mutates the store.
